title: chore: run cspell on lint staged for markdown files
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Run cspell on markdown files on lint staged.

Resolves #4119 

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

Although eslint supports code linting in markdown, it doesn't check other parts of it. It is advised to not use cspell and eslint together at once.

> Due to the nature of how files are parsed, the cspell command line tool and this eslint plugin will give different results. It is recommended that either eslint or cspell checks a file, but not both.

I noticed that eslint cspell isn't used for markdown files, so I used cspell cli that uses it's own config file. I tested it and there aren't any spelling issues in markdowns.

### :clipboard: Tasks

Make sure you

- [x] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://mermaid.js.org/community/contributing.html)
- [ ] :computer: have added necessary unit/e2e tests.
- [ ] :notebook: have added documentation. Make sure [`MERMAID_RELEASE_VERSION`](https://mermaid.js.org/community/contributing.html#update-documentation) is used for all new features.
- [ ] :butterfly: If your PR makes a change that should be noted in one or more packages' changelogs, generate a changeset by running `pnpm changeset` and following the prompts. Changesets that add features should be `minor` and those that fix bugs should be `patch`. Please prefix changeset messages with `feat:`, `fix:`, or `chore:`.
author: kriss-u

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body: Using 'pnpm dlx cspell' will download and execute cspell on every run, which is inefficient. Consider installing cspell as a dev dependency and using 'pnpm cspell' instead to avoid repeated downloads.

comments.author: kriss-u
comments.body:
It won't execute cspell on every run since it's on lint staged and only run on pre-commit on matched staged markdown files. Since cspell is already on dev dependency, I could do that as well. Would you like to have this change @shubhamparikh2704? 

This isn't urgent but just to clear the issues list.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: Yes, please fix it. We don't need to use `dlx` unnecessarily.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Flags an inefficiency and suggests a concrete fix: install cspell as a dev dependency and use 'pnpm cspell' instead of 'pnpm dlx cspell'.
Provides a direct code suggestion to change the command from 'pnpm dlx cspell' to 'pnpm cspell'.
